Theorem
[Hamilton's 3-Manifold Theorem] 1. ch12:12.37

If $M$ is a simply connected compact Riemannian $3$-manifold with positive-definite Ricci curvature, then $M$ is diffeomorphic to $S^3$.

This is Hamilton's theorem [Ham82].
